|PRESENTER pool-fs R5/11                  12:41:07 |
|the writer writes hello.txt                       |
|$ kubectl exec writer -- /demo/fswrite "Hello from|
|    the writer, $(date +%T)"                      |
|-> rrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr|
|   rrrrrrrrrrrrr                                  |
|-> rrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr|
|   12.3 s (command 10.1 s); Enter: next           |
+--------------------------------------------------+
+--------------------------------------------------+ T1 pool-fs ext4 R6
|PRESENTER pool-fs R6/11                  12:41:07 |
|three readers start: two on vm2, one on vm1       |
|$ kubectl apply -f pool-fs/readers.yaml           |
|-> rrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr|
|   rrrrrrrrrrrrr                                  |
|-> rrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr|
|   12.3 s (command 10.1 s); Enter: next           |
+--------------------------------------------------+
+--------------------------------------------------+ T1 pool-fs ext4 R7
|PRESENTER pool-fs R7/11                  12:41:07 |
|readers ask to read: vm1's reader at once, vm2's  |
|  must wait                                       |
|$ for r in reader-a reader-b reader-c; do kubectl |
|    exec $r -- cxl-request request --serial       |
|    0xc1ae0001 --shared --mode fs --name data     |
|    --wait 0s; done                               |
|-> rrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr|
|   rrrrrrrrrrrrr                                  |
|   12.3 s (command 10.1 s); Enter: next           |
+--------------------------------------------------+
+--------------------------------------------------+ T1 pool-fs ext4 R8
|PRESENTER pool-fs R8/11                  12:41:07 |
|the writer adds a line; vm1's reader sees it at   |
|  once                                            |
|$ kubectl exec writer -- /demo/fswrite --append "A|
|    second line, $(date +%T)"; kubectl exec       |
|    reader-c -- cat /run/cxl/fs/data/hello.txt    |
|-> rrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr|
|   rrrrrrrrrrrrr                                  |
|-> rrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr|
|   12.3 s (command 10.1 s); Enter: next           |
+--------------------------------------------------+
+--------------------------------------------------+ T1 pool-fs ext4 R9
|PRESENTER pool-fs R9/11                  12:41:07 |
|the writer is done: vm1 turns the filesystem      |
|  read-only, vm2's readers mount it               |
|$ kubectl exec writer -- cxl-request release --all|
|-> rrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr|
|   rrrrrrrrrrrrr                                  |
|-> rrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr|
|   12.3 s (command 10.1 s); Enter: next           |
+--------------------------------------------------+
+--------------------------------------------------+ T1 pool-fs ext4 R10
|PRESENTER pool-fs R10/11                 12:41:07 |
|each reader reads hello.txt; a write fails        |
|$ for r in reader-a reader-b reader-c; do kubectl |
|    exec $r -- cat /run/cxl/fs/data/hello.txt;    |
|    done; kubectl exec reader-a -- sh -c 'echo x  |
|    >> /run/cxl/fs/data/hello.txt'                |
|-> rrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr|
|   rrrrrrrrrrrrr                                  |
|-> rrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr|
|   12.3 s (command 10.1 s); Enter: next           |
+--------------------------------------------------+
+--------------------------------------------------+ T1 pool-fs ext4 R11
|PRESENTER pool-fs R11/11                 12:41:07 |
|everything goes away                              |
|$ kubectl delete -f pool-fs/                      |
|-> rrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr|
|   rrrrrrrrrrrrr                                  |
|-> rrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr|
|   12.3 s (command 10.1 s); Enter: next           |
+--------------------------------------------------+
+--------------------------------------------------+ T1 pool-fs xfs R1
|PRESENTER pool-fs R1/11                  12:41:07 |
|a writer starts on vm1; it has no CXL memory yet  |
|$ kubectl apply -f pool-fs/writer.yaml            |
|-> rrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr|
|   rrrrrrrrrrrrr                                  |
|-> rrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr|
|   12.3 s (command 10.1 s); Enter: next           |
+--------------------------------------------------+
+--------------------------------------------------+ T1 pool-fs xfs R2
|PRESENTER pool-fs R2/11                  12:41:07 |
|the writer asks for the device as a block device  |
|$ kubectl exec writer -- cxl-request request      |
|    --serial 0xc1ae0001 --mode block              |
|-> rrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr|
|   rrrrrrrrrrrrr                                  |
|-> rrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr|
|   12.3 s (command 10.1 s); Enter: next           |
+--------------------------------------------------+
+--------------------------------------------------+ T1 pool-fs xfs R3
|PRESENTER pool-fs R3/11                  12:41:07 |
|the writer makes an empty xfs filesystem on it    |
|$ kubectl exec writer -- /demo/mkfs --type xfs    |
|-> rrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr|
|   rrrrrrrrrrrrr                                  |
|-> rrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr|
|   12.3 s (command 10.1 s); Enter: next           |
+--------------------------------------------------+
+--------------------------------------------------+ T1 pool-fs xfs R4
|PRESENTER pool-fs R4/11                  12:41:07 |
|the writer mounts it read-write instead           |
|$ kubectl exec writer -- sh -c 'cxl-request       |
|    release --all && cxl-request request --serial |
|    0xc1ae0001 --shared --mode fs --read-write    |
|    --name data'                                  |
|-> rrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr|
|   rrrrrrrrrrrrr                                  |
|-> rrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr|
|   12.3 s (command 10.1 s); Enter: next           |
+--------------------------------------------------+
